title: Matte Black Glass Shelf, 16-Inch Triple Tier Wall-Mounted Shelf, Solid Brass & Tempered Glass, Allied Brass
description: Finished in Matte Black, glass shelf for bathroom organization: 16 inches wide (16-inch, 16 in) x 5 inches deep wall mount, triple tier vanity glass shelf with solid brass hardware and tempered glass shelves, which makes a bold, modern statement with its sleek, non-reflective surface that anchors contemporary bathroom designs. Contemporary design for modern bathroom hardware and contemporary bath accessories; ideal for toiletries, cosmetics, and everyday essentials while keeping counters clear. Features 3/8-in thick (0.38 in) tempered, beveled-edge glass and concealed screw mounting for a clean, minimalist bathroom fixtures look. Wall-mounted / wall mount installation; includes glass shelf and all installation hardware and uses #8 x 1 1/4" screws. Rated 6 lb weight capacity. Multiple designer finish options. Limited Lifetime Warranty. Allied Brass.
